_project: Tidal Flight 2026 — Concept 4: amphibious twin-pontoon, cruciform-tail, distributed-propulsion series-hybrid seaplane
_purpose: Single editable input dictionary for preliminary geometry, aerodynamic drag, hydrodynamic screens, series-hybrid propulsion, component weights, requirements and mission planning.
_design_status: Geometry synchronized to the supplied OpenVSP file. Source ratings, aero coefficients and component mass/performance assumptions remain preliminary.

_module_map.concept4_geometry: SeaplaneGeom (two floats, float struts, distributed motor nacelles, cruciform mount)
_module_map.aerodynamics: SeaplaneAero (lift limits, high-lift configurations, preliminary polar parameters)
_module_map.concept4_aerodynamics: SeaplaneAero (optional calibrated drag / stopped prop drag)
_module_map.aero_reference_condition: SeaplaneAero (default atmosphere and airspeed for CD0)
_module_map.propulsion: SeaplaneProp (electric bus, generator, motor, battery and fuel)
_module_map.sizing: run_concept4_study fixed-CAD budget; optional run_concept4_resizing_study changes the wing
_module_map.missions: Concept4Mission integrated phase source and battery accounting

horizontal_tail._configuration: Cruciform: horizontal stabilizer mounts partway up the vertical fin; mount fraction is under concept4_geometry.
horizontal_tail._note: Measured fixed OpenVSP planform. Volume coefficient is derived, not a stability target.

vertical_tail._configuration: Single vertical fin supporting a cruciform-mounted horizontal tail.
vertical_tail._note: Measured fixed OpenVSP planform. Volume coefficient is derived, not a stability target.

fuselage._note: Illustrative 9-passenger + 2-pilot cabin, NOT the six-seat classroom fuselage. Verify a 35-inch minimum seat pitch, 17.5-inch minimum seat width, 2-inch minimum armrests, 20-inch minimum aisle, egress, volume and cargo layout.

geometry._note: Native OpenVSP baseline. Tails, body, pontoons and pods stay fixed in the virtual wing-area sweep.
geometry._comment: S_ref starts at the 325-ft² CAD area. Reference AR is 12.603076923, with a 64-ft span.
geometry._source: OpenVSP native WingGeom, CompGeom, DegenGeom and surface bounds. Imported values and source hash are under geometry.openvsp.
geometry._input_status: Reference wing and tail areas/spans, fuselage, floats, pods and native wetted areas are imported. Virtual wing-area sweeps are explicitly separate from the fixed CAD baseline.

landing_gear._note: Wheels are integrated with the pontoons. Water takeoff/landing configurations MUST be gear_up. Gear fractions in weights are a separate preliminary assumption; no wheelbase loads are yet calculated.

source.units: ft interpreted from model parameters; numerical dimensions retained

notes: Native CompGeom intersected wetted areas; rotating propeller blade areas excluded from airframe parasite drag.
CAD dimensions are geometry only. Quarter-MAC arms are not CG-based stability derivatives.
Body and pod dimensions from native stored BBox validated by fresh native bounds; wing planform parameters from WingGeom.
Main wing only scales in the constraint family at fixed AR and taper. Tails, floats, struts, pods and fuselage remain fixed.
Stored MeshGeom was removed only in the transient OpenVSP analysis process; the source file was not written.

concept4_geometry._status: OpenVSP synchronized; performance/structures and aero coefficients remain assumptions.

floats._source: Illustrative twin-float initial geometry, not a verified comparator design.

float_struts._source: Illustrative four float support struts; strut count/geometry must follow structural layout.

motor_nacelles._source: Six representative wing-mounted motor pods, one per propulsor; count must match propulsion.n_motors.

cruciform_tail._source: 0.55 is an illustrative fraction of vertical-fin height; not an aerodynamic validation.

concept4_geometry._comment: Dimensions and areas synchronized to the supplied CAD. Structure, thermal installation and aerodynamic coefficients remain preliminary.
concept4_geometry._openvsp_note: Populate named component areas after OpenVSP CompGeom validation; do not insert arbitrary areas simply to match a target CD0. Names: wing, horizontal_tail, vertical_tail, fuselage, pontoons, float_struts, motor_nacelles.

aerodynamics._comment: Component parasite drag is computed dynamically using Reynolds-dependent skin friction, component form factors, interference factors, and wetted area. CD0_clean and Cfe are comparison/reference values, not replacements for the buildup.
aerodynamics._source: NASA OpenVSP Parasite Drag Tool and Raymer for conceptual CD0 buildup; legacy high-lift and flap increments are unverified and must be replaced with selected wing/flap data.
aerodynamics._CLmax_note: 1.5, 1.8, and 2.2 are starting inputs for clean, takeoff, and landing; NO extra blown-wing CLmax credit has been given to distributed propulsion.
aerodynamics._gear_note: The flap+gear increments are applied only for configurations whose name ends with gear_down. Water operations must use gear_up.
aerodynamics._stopped_prop_note: The legacy fixed delta_CD0_propeller_stopped is retained only for reference; the active distributed-propulsion code will refuse to apply stopped-prop drag without a value under concept4_aerodynamics.

concept4_aerodynamics._note: Unmeasured excrescence and failed-motor drag are NOT assumed zero by validation; additional_calibrated_cd0=0 is the initial model omission. stopped_propeller_cd0_increment=null deliberately prevents a false OEI drag claim.

aero_reference_condition._note: RFP 180-KTAS cruise capability at 10,000-ft density altitude. The ISA code approximates density altitude with ISA altitude.

hydrodynamics._status: First-order hydrostatics and published Savitsky planing-screening ONLY

_sources.savitsky: Savitsky (1964), Hydrodynamic Design of Planing Hulls, doi:10.5957/mt1.1964.1.4.71
_sources.planing_ittc: ITTC-1957 friction correlation, see Savitsky literature
_sources.buoyancy: 14 CFR 23.2310 and the team RFP 80% excess buoyancy, below-cabin-floor restriction

hydrodynamics._comment: Hydrostatics use a constant waterplane approximation and available displacement volume. Water-running resistance uses a prismatic-planing Savitsky-type screen ONLY in its supported regime. Hump drag, step hydrodynamics, porpoising, 20-deg heel, flooding and 2000-ft water takeoff are NOT evaluated.
hydrodynamics._assumption_status: Block coefficient, waterplane coefficient, KG, trim, deadrise, and float outer dimensions are illustrative and must be replaced with float geometry/cg; DO NOT equate small-angle GM with RFP stability compliance.
hydrodynamics._buoyancy_note: The RFP and 14 CFR 23.2310 require buoyancy equivalent to 1.8*MTOW in fresh water. The RFP counts only volume below the cabin floor. null eligible-volume fraction deliberately means no compliance determination until watertight compartment volumes are established.

_sources.architecture: NASA Electrified Aircraft Propulsion, Aircraft Configurations (series hybrid).
_sources.P_SL_hp: Inherited preliminary team total electric motor shaft rating; not optimized.
_sources.n_motors: Six-motor scenario; must match the number of motor nacelles.
_sources.n_generators: One-turbogenerator scenario; generator failure requires battery-only contingency analysis.
_sources.generator_engine_shaft_power_sl_hp_each: Provisional turboshaft shaft rating; no engine selected.
_sources.BSFC_lb_per_hp_hr: Prior team 0.40 assumption, unsuitable as validated turboshaft fuel-performance evidence.
_sources.generator_lapse_exponent: Preliminary sigma^0.8 power lapse, not a calibrated engine deck.
_sources.efficiencies: All conversion efficiencies are preliminary, require selected component performance maps.
_sources.battery_specific_energy_kwh_per_kg: 300 Wh/kg preliminary installed-system assumption, not verified at pack level.
_sources.battery_specific_power_kw_per_kg: 2 kW/kg preliminary; thermal and duty ratings unresolved.
_sources.inverter_specific_power_kw_per_kg: 10.6 kW/kg research converter reference; not a qualified production rating.
_sources.generator_specific_power_kw_per_kg: Illustrative only; generator power rating basis = electrical output.
_sources.turboshaft_specific_power_kw_per_kg: Illustrative only; require vendor engine mass/performance.
_sources.propeller_mass_kg_each: Illustrative only; size by thrust/RPM/diameter and vendor data.

propulsion._comment: Series-hybrid: turboshaft drives generator, rectifier supplies DC bus, inverter/motors turn six distributed propellers; battery supplies the bus during zero-tailpipe-emission phases and can supplement or recharge in flight.
propulsion._input_status: Architecture confirmed for Concept 4; one generator and six motors are a SCENARIO, not selected hardware. All power, BSFC, efficiency, storage, mass and rating inputs are unvalidated placeholders.
propulsion._bsfc_warning: 0.40 lb/(engine shaft hp*hr) was inherited from the prior piston aircraft assumption. It is NOT a validated turboshaft BSFC; obtain an engine-specific part-load/altitude map before using fuel-burn outputs in THW5 conclusions.
propulsion._energy_note: No external charging is allowed as a mission prerequisite. A dispatch/turnaround study must confirm battery state at the start of each leg; available generator recharge alone has not been proven.
propulsion._rating_note: P_SL_hp is TOTAL electric motor shaft peak rating (not generator output or turboshaft output). Motor continuous rating and generator output are limited separately.

payload._calculation: 9*(180+50) + 2*180 = 2430 lbf, including two pilots; no extra pilot baggage unless separately specified.
payload._source: Tidal Flight Seaplane RFP 2026, aircraft requirements.

weights._comment: Component-level initial OEW model. Wing, horizontal tail and vertical tail use planform area; fuselage uses wetted area. Floats/float supports/gear, cabin systems and installed propulsive hardware have separate rows. The battery is counted in OEW and FUEL is not.
weights._model_status: Values are conceptual starting assumptions and may overpredict or underpredict weight. The 12,500-lbf gross weight is only a design target, NOT an RFP or FAA maximum.
weights._source_unit_weights: Raymer, Aircraft Design: A Conceptual Approach, GA component-area statistical method; not validated for DEP + seaplane structure.
weights._factor_note: 1.10 wing reinforcement and 1.08 fin factors are illustrative penalties; hull_factor=1 because Concept 4 is a floatplane rather than a flying-boat hull. Actual pontoon attachment loads and tail loads must be designed.
weights._float_gear_note: Float/attachment fractions (0.08/0.02) are placeholders; geometry-based float mass, reinforced steps, watertight bulkheads, and amphibious wheel/actuator mass are needed. The GA 0.057 landing-gear reference is NOT a validated float-mounted amphibious gear mass.

propulsion_integration._note: All installation fractions are unverified; replace with wire-length, thermal, nacelle and mounting hardware estimates.

control_systems._note: First-order budget fractions; cabin features, redundant controls, FIKI equipment, and hybrid-electric distribution require a component-level system buildup. Avoid double-counting propulsion electrical wiring.

weights._fuel_note: Approximate Jet-A-class fuel volume check only. Final fuel and tank sizing require selected fuel and usable-tank geometry.
weights._code_note: SeaplaneWeights.OEW(W_TO) recalculates based on the PASSED candidate W_TO and current injected geom/prop; it does not solve the mission itself.

rfp_performance_requirements._source: Tidal Flight — Seaplane RFP 2026 (uploaded by team); requirements are binding unless labeled desirable.
rfp_performance_requirements._noise_note: 80 dB is a desirable attribute in the RFP, not a shall-level hard constraint.
rfp_performance_requirements._engine_out_note: Assess one electric motor/propulsor out AND common-source generator failure separately; do not assume they are equivalent.

_src_design_range_nmi: Required 1000 statute miles divided by 1.150779448 statute miles/nmi. For the conservative baseline, all 868.976 nmi are assigned to cruise, without credit for climb distance.

sizing._comment: The following are initial guesses and numerical controls, NOT the verified sized-aircraft answer. Future coupled loop must update gross weight, S_ref, motor shaft power, generator rating, battery capacity, usable SOC and fuel mass together.
sizing._target_note: 12,500 lbf is a TEAM sizing objective shown in earlier project materials, NOT a ceiling stated by the RFP or 14 CFR Part 23.
sizing._convergence_note: Convergence must not be declared by TOGW alone; verify power/energy feasibility, structural/float volume feasibility, geometry span cap and steady SOC across mission legs. No coupled driver is yet provided.
sizing._example_mass_budget_warning: At the sample 12500-lbf W_TO and 350-ft2 wing, the uploaded SeaplaneWeights component build-up estimates OEW around 10090 lbf with current 300-kWh battery and drivetrain placeholders. With the 2430-lbf fixed payload, remaining fuel allowance is NEGATIVE (~-20 lbf). This configuration does not close at the team 12500-lbf target and needs an actual coupled mass/power/energy trade; it is NOT a viable sized aircraft.

constraints._comment: Requirement points and analysis condition definitions for a FUTURE Concept 4 constraint model. Water run and hydrostatics are not represented by an airplane land-takeoff parameter. The IHW3 TTPA matching-diagram implementation is not directly compatible with these types.

design_point._status: Initial scenario 12500 lbf / 350 ft^2 / 1350 shaft hp; NOT feasibility/least-engine selection.

conditions.name: RFP water takeoff, 50-ft obstacle
conditions._note: Requires displacement+hump+planing acceleration and airborne climb; no land-TOP surrogate.

conditions.name: RFP best ROC at MSL ISA
conditions._note: Use actual speed sweep and available generator+battery power; do not assume 100-KTAS best ROC.

conditions.name: RFP best ROC at 10000-ft density altitude
conditions._note: Use air-density and power curves, best ROC found by speed sweep.

conditions.name: RFP OEI at MSL ISA: one motor inoperative
conditions._note: If multiengine rule applies, verify motor failure and drag/yaw; no fixed piston twin split.

conditions.name: Generator-out contingency
conditions._note: One-generator scenario loses all fuel-generated bus power; battery energy/power remaining must be demonstrated.

conditions.name: Balked landing at start of IFR reserve
conditions._note: The RFP requires the maneuver but does not specify a numerical 3% gradient.

conditions.name: RFP cruise capability at MTOW
conditions._note: MTOW cruise speed requirement, not a 180-KTAS maximum allowed operating speed.

missions._comment: These are mission SCHEMAS, not completed fuel/energy integrations. They must be run through a future series-hybrid mission model calling SeaplaneProp.power_balance() at every sufficiently short time step. A Breguet effective BSFC fraction cannot substitute for battery SOC integration.

std_mission._description: Conservative 1000-statute-mile full-payload mission and explicit balked landing plus 45-min reserve.
std_mission._reserve_note: The IFR 45-minute reserve is modeled explicitly; no legacy automatic reserve-fuel multiplier is applied.

segments.name: Electric taxi and water maneuver
segments._note: Taxi duration must come from operations model; engine off on water.

segments.name: Electric-only water takeoff
segments._note: Time/power must come from coupled hydro-aero water-takeoff acceleration.

segments.name: Climb to 10000-ft density altitude
segments._note: Segment energy use must be integrated with climb performance and SOC.

segments.name: Cruise at team preliminary speed
segments._note: The cruise distance is conservative RFP full-distance allocation; 180-KTAS RFP capability is a separate constraint.

segments.name: Balked landing at start of reserve
segments._note: Mandatory RFP reserve-entry maneuver. Mission solver must explicitly support this phase and its energy demand.

segments.name: 45-min IFR energy reserve
segments._note: 4000 ft / 120 KTAS are preliminary design choices; RFP only specifies 45 minutes of energy.

typical_500nmi_route._description: Optional operations/economics route; RFP 1000-statute-mile case still governs compliance.

initial_example_only._note: Demo inputs drive run_aero_hydro.py. 12,500 lbf is a scenario/previous team design target; running the demo does NOT prove payload/weight closure or RFP performance.

constraint_plot.note: Water wall is an unvalidated over-50-ft approach/flare/constant-deceleration proxy. Flight-power shading does not establish water takeoff, landing, mission or failure feasibility.
